title: Kinetic theory for Transformers and the lost-in-the-middle phenomenon
abstract: arXiv:2605.09213v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study causal self-attention dynamics -- a toy model for decoder Transformers -- which we interpret as a non-exchangeable interacting particle system. Adapting cumulant expansions to the triangular causal dependency structure of the model, and appealing to non-hierarchical methods to estimate correlations using Glauber calculus, we prove a quantitative mean-field limit result and a next-order characterization of correlations. For iid uniformly distributed tokens, the limiting correlation equation can be solved in closed form and we obtain a rigorous explanation of the empirically observed \emph{lost-in-the-middle} phenomenon: the token retrieval profile, as a function of the source position in the prompt, is $\mathsf{U}$-shaped, with primacy, recency, and a unique interior minimum under an explicit smallness condition.

translated_title: Transformers的动理学理论与“迷失在中间”现象
translated_abstract: 我们研究因果自注意力动力学——这是解码器Transformer的一个玩具模型——并将其解释为一个非可交换的相互作用粒子系统。通过将累积量展开方法适配到该模型的三角因果依赖结构，并借助基于Glauber演算的非层级方法来估计相关性，我们证明了定量的平均场极限结果以及相关性的下一阶刻画。对于独立同分布且均匀分布的词元，极限相关方程可以闭式求解，从而我们为经验上观察到的“迷失在中间”现象提供了一个严格的解释：词元检索性能作为其在提示中源位置的函数呈U形，在显式的小性条件下表现出首因效应、近因效应以及唯一的内部最小值。
tldr: 该论文将Transformer的因果自注意力建模为非可交换相互作用粒子系统，通过平均场极限与累积量展开分析，首次严格证明了“迷失在中间”现象，即词元检索性能随其在提示中的位置呈U形分布。
en_tdlr: This paper models causal self-attention in Transformers as a non-exchangeable interacting particle system and, through quantitative mean-field limit and cumulant expansion analysis, provides a rigorous explanation of the "lost-in-the-middle" phenomenon, showing that token retrieval follows a U-shaped profile with respect to the token's position in the prompt.
